newsitem.title: UK: NatWest to pay over bln stg in UK loan deal.
newsitem.headline: NatWest to pay over bln stg in UK loan deal.

text.p: The British government expects to receive more than one billion stg from the sale of the Housing Corporation's loan portfolio to NatWest Markets housing minister David Curry said on Thursday.

In a written parliamentary answer, Curry said contracts were exchanged with NatWest on Wednesday for the sale of the portfolio, made up of loans with a face value of 907 million stg as at October 31 last year.

He said it was impossible to give an exact figure for the purchase price because it was subject to changes in the portfolio and movements in the gilt rate between now and completion at the end of March.
"However, at today's rate a substantial premium over book value will be paid," Curry said.

"Five hundred million pounds will be received before the end of this financial year as anticipated in spending plans, and I confidently expect that the further 500 million anticipated in next year's plans will be exceeded when the balance is received on April 1," he added. -- London Newsroom +44 171 5427767
